name: @workadventure/voice-vad-eval
description: Test-only: offline comparison of the voice worker's volume gate with a Silero speech detector, and load measurements of the worker with its switched-off-by-default speech observer. Not part of any image.

scripts.parity: ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 tsx src/parity.ts data out "silero p>=0.50 for 64 ms"
scripts.bench: ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 tsx src/bench.ts data/silero_vad_v6.2.3.onnx native 20 30 data/ms-snsd/noise_test/Typing_1.wav
scripts.yield-replay: tsx src/yield-replay.ts data results/raw.jsonl.gz out report && tsx src/yield-report.ts out && cp out/yield-replay.md results/yield-replay.md
